# Workstation's live feed grid snaps back to the top on every tick

## Context

On the v13.3.1 candidate (`dev` `e2f77dd0fb`), the Workstation's Live Event Stream grid throws away a reader's scroll position at the next feed tick. A scratch probe (Chromium, e2e config, 1600×900) scrolled the feed's grid view to 600 px and sampled it every 100 ms. It held for about 500 ms, returned to 0 and stayed there, in 2 of 2 runs. Whatever the user scrolls to is gone within half a second, so nothing below the newest rows can be read. I reported it as a defect-note on 2026-10-19 and never filed it. Under the operator's ruling recorded on #20022 (*"every know grid and docklayouts and apps/workstation bug is a release blocker"*), it blocks v13.3.1.

## The Problem

`Workstation.store.Feed` produces 5 records every 500 ms. `appendBatch` calls `add(records)`, then `splice` trims the oldest records beyond `maxRecords`. The store sorts by `id` descending, so the newest rows sit at the top. Each of the two calls fires the Store's `load`. `grid.Body#onStoreLoad` treats every `load` without `postChunkLoad` as a new dataset and, 50 ms later, dispatches `DomAccess.scrollTo({direction: 'top', value: 0})`. A tick is therefore two resets.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/grid/Body.mjs` `onStoreLoad`: `if (me.mounted && !postChunkLoad)` → scroll to top.
- `src/data/Store.mjs` `onCollectionMutate` publishes `postChunkLoad: me.#appendNotification || (streaming && !isFirstChunk)`. The private `#appendNotification` is set in two places only:
  - `addLoadedItems` (private; load append, #19368);
  - `setData(data, {continuation})` (public; data assignment, #19566).
  
  Each repeats the same save/set/restore-in-`finally` idiom.
- A sorted insert sorts silently (`collection.Base#splice` → `doSort(undefined, true)`), so no `sort` load joins the two `mutate` loads.
- Design authority: #19566 — *"`Neo.data.Store` owns the intent on data assignment. `Grid` must consume the existing notification contract; a new view-local scroll policy would treat the symptom."* `Store#setData` documents `options.continuation` as *"Whether this assignment continues the current data view."* A feed tick continues the current view. Ordinary adds keep their reset by the same contract (#19566's ledger), so the producer has to declare the continuation.
- The Feed has no way to declare it:
  - `setData` reassigns the whole data config, which would re-create up to 500 records twice a second and give every row a fresh record identity.
  - `addLoadedItems` is private.

## The Fix

1. `Neo.data.Store` gets one public synchronous method, `asContinuation(fn)`. It runs `fn`, and every `load` that `fn`'s mutations fire carries `postChunkLoad: true`. It restores the previous context afterwards, also when `fn` throws, and returns `fn`'s result. `addLoadedItems` and `setData` call it, so the idiom exists once.
2. `Workstation.store.Feed#appendBatch` runs its `add` and its trimming `splice` inside `asContinuation`.

`grid.Body` does not change, and neither does the default for ordinary mutations.

### Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Behavior | Default / fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Store#asContinuation(fn)` (new) | the existing continuation context behind `addLoadedItems` / `setData` | runs `fn` synchronously; its mutations' `load` events carry `postChunkLoad: true`; restores the prior context after a return or a throw; nests | outside it, mutations publish ordinary loads (unchanged) | method JSDoc | AC-2 |
| `Store#setData(data, {continuation})`, `Store#addLoadedItems` | #19566, #19368 | unchanged, now through `asContinuation` | — | existing JSDoc | AC-2 (existing specs) |
| `Workstation.store.Feed#appendBatch` | this ticket | a tick no longer resets a bound grid's scroll | — | `Feed` JSDoc | AC-1, AC-3 |

Decision Record impact: none (an additive use of the existing `postChunkLoad` contract).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: a red-first e2e arm on the Workstation. With the Live Event Stream scrolled down, its scroll position survives at least three feed ticks. On `e2f77dd0fb` the position falls back to 0 within one tick. At the top, the newest events still appear at the top.
- [ ] AC-2: unit:
  - inside `asContinuation`, the `load` from `add` and from `splice` carries `postChunkLoad: true`;
  - after it returns or throws, the next ordinary mutation's `load` does not;
  - a nested call restores the outer context.

  The existing append and `setData` specs (`data/StoreApiPipeline.spec.mjs`, `grid/StoreInteractions.spec.mjs` and #19566's) stay green.
- [ ] AC-3: a mounted grid observes no top-reset dispatch for a feed tick and still observes it for an ordinary assignment.
- [ ] AC-4 (post-merge): covered by #20022's three full runs.

## Out of Scope

- Keeping the same rows in view while scrolled away (scroll anchoring). New events still insert above the viewport, so the rows under a scrolled-away reader move down 5 rows per tick. That needs a grid policy (anchor on the first visible record), not this contract. It can be a follow-up if the operator wants it in the patch.
- Changing the reset default for ordinary mutations (#19566's contract).
